answer: Require every identity to bind a short-lived proof to the current public randomness beacon, then grow influence only along a trellis of unique, independently countersigned work. The beacon rotates each epoch, so proofs cannot be precomputed or reused. A node on the trellis counts only when distinct peers attest it; shared timing or counterparties collapse those edges. A raven farm can hatch many shells, but every extra bird must remine a fresh beacon and keep its own live trellis, or its weight falls to zero.
